If “oatmeal” sounds responsible, don’t worry. Oatmeal Chocolate Chip brought chocolate chips. This Soft-Baked Cookie is chewy in that cozy-oat way, with a pinch of Himalayan pink salt to keep the sweetness nicely balanced.
It’s a classic that makes snack time feel a little more put-together without asking anything extra from you.

WHAT YOU'LL NEVER FIND IN A SKOUT COOKIE:

FAQs

Great taste is our first ingredient! The mix of our simple organic ingredients make our bars taste amazing! We pride ourselves on making snacks that taste like what comes from your grandmother's kitchen (presuming she is a great baker).

None of that overly sweet taste that comes from artificial sweeteners or that chemical taste that comes from things you cannot pronounce. Our snack flavors are the kind that you can enjoy from first to last bit each and every time.

We make a variety of flavors that even the pickiest of eaters will find a flavor or two to enjoy. Happy Snacking!

We ship anywhere in the US, including Hawaii and Alaska. (Shipping rates may vary)

We also ship internationally to:

  • Australia
  • New Zealand
  • United Kingdom
  • European Union

Our kids bars are suitable under adult supervision for children over the age of one years old who are able to eat solid foods. Our bars are made of about 60-70% organic dates so they are soft in texture and easy to chew.

All of our products are:

  • Certified Organic (Oregon Tilth)
  • Certified Vegan (Vegan.org)
  • Certified Gluten Free (GFCO)
  • Certified Plastic Neutral (rePurpose Global)

All of our products are also

  • Gluten-free
  • Dairy-free
  • Soy-free
  • Seed-oil free
  • Dye-free

We believe parents deserve complete transparency about what they’re feeding their families. You can find the full ingredient list for each product directly on its individual product page.

Our kids' bars contain 7 or less organic ingredients, Soft-Baked Cookies 10 or less organic ingredients and protein bars have have 5 or less orgnaic ingredients

Every Skout snack is made with simple, organic ingredients you can recognize and pronounce — no artificial flavors, preservatives, or unnecessary fillers. We keep our recipes straightforward so you always know exactly what’s inside.

If you ever have a specific ingredient question, our team is happy to help.

Our Small Batch bars are limited edition flavors that are only available on our website.

We offer fun and unique new flavors exclusively to our web shoppers and once they sell out they're gone so if there's a flavor you'd like to try, try it before it's gone!

We have partnered with Onward to provide carbon neutral shipping protection against lost, stolen and damaged packages. When you add Onward to your order, you will be fully protected in the event something goes wrong with your shipment. Simply add Onward to your cart at checkout and you will have full protection should something go wrong with your shipment.

All Skout products are shelf-stable and can be stored in your pantry, no refrigeration needed.

  • Kids Bars: 12-month shelf life from the date of production
  • Cookies: 9-month shelf life from the date of production

For best freshness, store in a cool, dry place.

Yes! Skout snacks are a great option for school lunches. They’re made with simple, organic ingredients and are free from gluten, dairy, and soy, making them a great fit for many classrooms.

Because school policies vary, we always recommend checking with your child’s school regarding specific allergen guidelines. For families navigating food sensitivities or ingredient concerns, our transparent ingredient lists make it easy to pack with confidence.

Portable, mess-free, and kid-approved, Skout snacks are designed to make lunch packing simple.

Customers say these oatmeal chocolate chip cookies are soft, chewy, and deliciously sweet with a satisfying texture. Many appreciate the simple, clean ingredients and find them perfect for kids and adults alike. The convenient two-cookie packaging works well for lunchboxes and on-the-go snacking. Some customers note the cookies tend to stick together in packages and can be crumbly when separated. Several mention the cookies are smaller than expected for the price, though most find them filling and flavorful enough to be addictive.
